Cache transfer is about how data is moved between the cache and the prefill/decode components.

Role switching is important here. Different components might handle different tasks, so switching roles can affect performance. Batch completion would involve handling multiple requests at once, which can impact throughput. GPU utilization is about how much of the GPU is being used, and throughput tradeoffs are the balance between processing speed and efficiency.
